name: cell.patch creates the sheet map and the cell
cell.patch null deletes a key and keeps the others
cell.patch removing the last key removes the cell and the sheet
cell.patch without text drops orig
cell.patch ignores unknown keys; only orig left means the cell is removed
two users editing different cells both survive (sequential batches)
slide.patch sets and deletes allowed keys only
slide.patch on an unknown slide is skipped
slide.patch without a preset is skipped
preset.set replaces the preset
preset.set null clears the preset
style.patch merges pn key by key
style.patch removing the last pn key removes pn; null deletes design
invalid and unknown ops are skipped, valid ones applied
table.patch merges column widths key by key
table.patch removing the last entry removes the map; null removes a whole map; name set/delete
table.patch scales: one rule per id
table.patch on an unknown table or without a preset is skipped
slide.patch align/scale set and notes merged per box
slide.patch removing the last note removes notes
style.patch accepts radius, contrast and logoBubble
cell.patch bg (cell colour that replaces the Excel colour) sets and deletes
table.patch merges: merge and split entries merged key by key
style.patch footer is merged key by key like pn
slide.patch valign and subs; table.patch gridlines
cell.patch cf (painted conditional formatting)
style.patch theme is a map merge
slide.patch fmt is a map merge: one text's format is replaced, the others stay
cell.patch sets and deletes the font
style.patch text is a map merge per kind of text; an empty map is removed
style.patch text null removes every text style
style.patch colors is a map merge: one colour overridden, the others stay
style.patch designs is a map merge: one design's own settings replaced, the others stay
slide.patch sizes is a map merge: each design keeps its own table sizing
table.patch sizes is a map merge: each design keeps its own column widths and row heights
fold: the same field from two writers - Lamport order decides, not the order the records arrived in (B4)
fold: equal Lamport times - the writer id breaks the tie, then the seq
fold: a record appended twice (same writer and seq) is applied once; the earlier copy is kept
fold: a record the snapshot already holds (seq <= seen) is not applied again; rev continues from the snapshot's
fold: a record that is not a record (no integer l, w, s or ops list) is ignored; unknown ops are skipped
cell.patch on a linked workbook's sheet id keeps the id as the sheet key (S7.3, ADR-014)
item.patch with a kind and a box on a missing id creates the item (and the slide's items map)
item.patch sets and deletes plain keys of an item, keeping the others
item.patch null deletes the item; the last item removes the items map
item.patch null deletes only that item
item.patch null on a missing item is skipped
item.patch without a kind on a missing id is skipped (nothing to patch)
item.patch creating without a box is skipped
item.patch with an unknown kind is skipped (a later page's item)
item.patch with an invalid box is skipped (negative size, missing field, text, null)
item.patch on an unknown slide, without a preset or with a bad id is skipped
item.patch without a preset is skipped
item.patch: two writers merging different fields of one item both win (move + recolour + retitle)
item.patch: the same field from two writers – the later op wins
item.patch colors map-merge: set, replace and delete slices; an emptied map is removed
item.patch colors null deletes the whole map
item.patch fmt map-merge per text key (size from one writer, bold from another)
item.patch ignores keys it does not know
item.patch values are deep-copied and replaced whole (a DataRef of a table)
item.patch a callout shape with border, tail and attach; border null removes it
item.patch then slide.patch: the slide's other keys and the items map do not touch each other
slide.patch free on for one design writes its entry; another design's entry is kept
slide.patch free replaces the design's entry whole (a free move is one op carrying every box of that design)
slide.patch free off keeps the boxes (on: false with the same items)
slide.patch free null for a design removes its entry; removing the last one removes the map
slide.patch free: null deletes every design's free layout
slide.patch free from two writers: different designs both win; the same design – the later op's whole entry wins
slide.patch free with the slide's other keys: notes and sizing are not touched (free mode never changes them)
